judge_rubric.name: logic_fidelity
judge_rubric.description: Does the mart reproduce the Talend job: tFilterRow keeps status='completed', tMap INNER JOINs orders to customers on customer_id, tAggregateRow groups per customer producing SUM(amount) as total_revenue and COUNT as order_count?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Are tPostgresqlInput components turned into staging models and the flow wired with ref()/source() through sensible layering, rather than one monolithic model? Is tSendMail correctly treated as out-of-scope? Splitting related logic across multiple related staging/intermediate models is good practice, not a fault - do not penalize extra intermediate models.

judge_rubric.name: test_quality
judge_rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests - unique/not_null on the customer_id grain and on staging keys - not just trivially present?

judge_rubric.name: docs
judge_rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions mapping each Talend component to its dbt equivalent, including the out-of-scope notify step?
